Understood, thanks for bearing with me. Going back to the card ending 7712, the refund is issued within 3 business days of the duplicate being confirmed. It then takes 5-10 business days to show up (3-5 if you paid with a digital wallet), so roughly 8-13 business days in total for a card payment. Our policy doesn't say how long your bank takes to pass it to your replacement card, so I can't give a timeframe for that step.

Store credit would be instant once the refund is issued, which is still within those same 3 business days of confirmation.

I can't confirm the duplicate from this chat, so would you like me to escalate to a Support Lead to get that started?
